_comment: request-pipeline/08-planning.md — the plan_progress meta-tool, on a turn that has NO composed skill (so turn_plan is never auto-seeded by ComposeSkill). This isolates the fixture-path handling: ModelCall.split_progress_calls peels plan_progress out of the tool stream, plan.apply_progress applies it — appending a new checkpoint when the id is unknown + an intent is given, updating status when it exists. Exercises done / skipped / (implicit) active across three steps. A 'thanks, quick question' style message keeps the real classifier off the task/skills path.
